name: plucked-text

frames.best_why: The string is pulled into a deep V under the cursor, so the pull and the tilting letters are both obvious.

tagline: Pull the line under a headline and let it twang back into place.
summary: A bold one-line headline resting on a taut string stretched between two dots. Drag the line down or sweep the cursor across it and the letters ride the vibration until it settles flat again.
appearance: A wide white sans headline centred on black, with a thin grey rule running under the baseline and a small dot at each end. A muted caption sits below the headline.
behaviour: Dragging the string bends it into a V under the pointer while the letters dip and tilt along it; releasing starts a damped ringing that eases flat. Sweeping the cursor across the line strums it without a click.
demo_content: The headline "Good vibrations" above the caption "Grab the string and let go, or sweep across it to strum."
search_phrases: headline on a string you can pull
text that wobbles like a guitar string
drag the line under the words and let go
interactive vibrating type for a hero
letters that bounce when the cursor crosses
rubber band line under a big title
playable headline effect for a landing page
how to make text swing on a wire
use_when: A short, bold hero headline should invite play, and a string metaphor suits the brand.
avoid_when: It handles one short line only and the stage captures touches, so pages cannot scroll over it on mobile.
customise: Pass the line through text, adjust how fast it rings with tension, and turn sweep-to-strum off with strum. The hairline colour and the clamp-based type scale come from classes.
weight_why: A single frame loop over a few wave modes that stops as soon as the string rests.

a11y.note: The full text is exposed to screen readers and reduced motion swaps ringing for a short ease, but there is no keyboard way to pluck it.

issues: The string is a hairline grey on black and easy to miss, so the pull affordance is not obvious.
polish_why: Believable string physics and crisp type; the hairline string is easy to overlook.
title: Plucked Text
